summary: I could not refute any identity or capability fact in the record; I re-checked every one against raw sources. The repo belongs to Google's verified HF org, and the launch blog's meta date of 2026-06-03 links to it. createdAt is 2026-05-23, the public squash commit is 2026-06-03 and lastModified is 2026-10-30, so the model falls inside the 12-month window. The license is Apache 2.0 in the card YAML, the HF tag and the linked page, which is titled "Apache License 2.0 | Gemma" and has no Terms of Use text. Parameters (11,959,730,224 BF16), the full architecture and max_position_embeddings 262144 (commit #21) match config.json. The card states the modalities and the 30 s audio / 60 s video limits. The chat template has the thinking toggle (enable_thinking defaults to false, at line 186) and native tool tokens. The vLLM v0.33.0 gemma4 parser and arch registrations sit at the cited lines. All 8 vendor benchmark values match the card exactly; they are self-reported, and the card does not state the thinking setting per column. All Artificial Analysis values match the page data. Minor corrections: the template's tool-message handling runs to about line 318, not 299. preserve_thinking only governs tool-call turns before the last user message; current-turn thinking is kept by the last_user_idx gate. Not confirmed: the AA "Telecom" domain label and the v4.1 index value of 22. Scratch files are in $SCRATCH/g12v/.
